import json, sys, shutil, random, time
shutil.copyfile('/app/submission/planner.py','/app/work/_tl.py')
sys.path.insert(0,'/app/work')
import _tl as planner, gen3, check
# simulate a time-limited first attempt
orig = planner._solve_primal
calls = {'n':0}
def patched(model, tight=False, presolve=True, limit=30.0, methods=('highs',)):
    calls['n'] += 1
    if calls['n'] == 1:
        limit = 1e-9   # force an immediate time-limit stop
    return orig(model, tight=tight, presolve=presolve, limit=limit, methods=methods)
planner._solve_primal = patched
rng = random.Random(4)
ok = 0; bad = 0
for i in range(25):
    r = gen3.gen(rng, big=(i%5==0))
    if r is None: continue
    raw = (json.dumps(r)+'\n').encode()
    prob = planner.parse_request(raw)
    calls['n'] = 0
    t0=time.time()
    resp = planner.solve(prob)
    errs = check.check(r, resp, verbose=False)
    if errs:
        bad += 1; print('FAIL', errs, json.dumps(r)[:200])
    else:
        ok += 1
print('time-limit-first-attempt: ok', ok, 'bad', bad)
"
